entries.title: A card you pick from the list on iPhone and iPad opens every time
entries.body: On iPhone and iPad, picking a card from the list under the stage could leave the list open and the card unchanged, when a reply notice cleared at the moment of your tap. The card you pick now opens, whatever else on the screen changes as you tap.
entries.noPicture: The list and the card look the same; the fix only keeps a pick from being lost when the screen redraws within a moment of the tap.
